locations.tag_prompt: space station interior, round windows, round buttons, planet ring, stars
locations.desc_en: Space station Star Bun where everything is round: windows, buttons, even emergency sandwiches.

locations.tag_prompt: hangar, old space shuttle, cracked paint, antenna
locations.desc_en: A hangar with an old space shuttle with cracked enamel and a fork-shaped antenna.

locations.tag_prompt: planet ring surface, candy rocks, blue planet, stars
locations.desc_en: The surface of a planet's ring, rocks like frozen sweets, a blue planet glowing in the distance.

panels.scene_en: a cosy round space station with round windows and buttons, a planet ring outside
Klarka paints stardust on the window glass, a blue parrot sits on her head like a cap

bubbles.speaker: klarka
bubbles.text: Dneska objevíme barvu, která neexistuje. Třeba zelenofialová se smíchem.

panels.scene_en: the round robot reports, lights blinking

bubbles.speaker: ladja
bubbles.text: Upozornění: prstenec planety chutná po malinách. Chyba. Měření opakujte.

panels.scene_en: the parrot clicks its beak, a door opens by itself and a pink cloud of cotton candy floats in, the commander watches

bubbles.speaker: nora
bubbles.text: To není nebezpečí. To je… dezert s gravitační poruchou.

panels.scene_en: in the hangar a shiny green alien frog dances in a bubble suit, the cotton candy follows it like a puppy

bubbles.speaker: zofka
bubbles.text: Kvák-díky! Můj prstenec ztratil sladkost. Bez ní planeta zapomene snít.

panels.scene_en: Klarka asks the parrot to translate

bubbles.speaker: klarka
bubbles.text: Bublino, přelož to prosím z žabího do papouščího.

panels.scene_en: the robot vacuums the cotton candy, which puffs up offended and wraps the whole hangar in a pink hug, Klarka finds three pencils

bubbles.speaker: klarka
bubbles.text: Výborně. Máme cukr, žábu a tužku s vlastním názorem.

panels.scene_en: on the ring Klarka sprinkles stardust over the cotton candy, the parrot squawks, the frog croaks, the robot spins its antenna and the ring glows pink-purple
the robot reports, the commander writes in the log

bubbles.speaker: nora
bubbles.text: Zapisuji do kroniky: zachránila nás dívka, papoušek a žába s cukrovým vouskem.

visual_tags: painting a house on a star
panels.scene_en: the parrot sits on the antenna like a lighthouse, the frog kisses the robot's tin head, Klarka paints a little house with a big kitchen on a star
